title: Kha Gaya Sani e Zahra Ko Alamdar
body:
Khaa Gaya Sani e Zehra Ko Alamdar Ka Gham
<<DIVIDER>>
Khooni Maqtal Mein Ridaon Ke, Nigedaar Ka Gham
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda Jab Tak Woh Raha Dekha, Na Dukh Ham Ne Koi
Na Kabhi Apni Ridaon Ki, Hamein Fikr Hui
Ab Toh Beparda Haram Dekhenge Bazar Ka Gham
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashe Akbar Ko Uthaya, Dafn Asghar Ko Kiya
Tukrhey Qasim Ke Chuney Phir Bhi Sabar Karta Raha
Maar Syed Ko Gaya Fauj, Ke Salar Ka Gham
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Ke Fizza Se Yeh Kehti Thi, Ali Ki Beti
Mere Qadmon Se Nighaa Jisne, Uthayi Na Kabhi
Kaise Bhulungi Bhala Aise, Hayadaar Ka Gham
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Chaader Na Koi Chehra, Chupane Ko Naqab
Maarta Hai Lab e Shah Pe Woh, Charhi Pi Ke Sharab
Maut Se Kam Toh Nahi Shaam, Ke Darbar Ka Gham
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye Mohsin Woh Garam Rait, Pe Soney Wali
Zakhm Sajjad Ke Ashqon Se, Woh Dhoney Waali
Saath Turbat Mein Gayi Leke, Wafadar Ka Gham
